claims.why: Uses a flow-through chamber when downhole DO sensor deployment is impractical.
Uses a positive-displacement submersible pump. Uses relatively gas-impermeable high-density plastic or fluorocarbon-polymer tubing.
Protects the exposed tubing and chamber from direct sunlight.
Taps the tubing with a blunt tool to dislodge entrained gas bubbles. Flushes dislodged bubbles from the tubing and chamber.
Eliminates back pressure in the chamber. Leaves the chamber outlet free flowing.
Lowers the DO and temperature sensors to the measuring point. Lowers the pump after the sensors. Monitors DO variation during purging.
Keeps the chamber outlet free flowing.
Secures the tubing fittings to prevent air from entering the cell. Explains that entering air can affect measurement accuracy and stability.
Uses a clean sample bottle. Rinses the bottle three times with the sample.
Rinses the measurement container three times with deionized water as part of preparation.
Fills the prepared bottle completely to the top. Caps the bottle tightly.
Records the field-measurement method where applicable.
Protects the exposed sample tubing from direct sunlight. Protects the chamber from direct sunlight.
Dislodges and flushes bubbles by tapping the tubing with a blunt tool.
Uses a blunt tool to tap the tubing and dislodge bubbles for flushing.
Eliminates back pressure in the flow-through chamber. Makes the outlet free flowing.
Lowers the DO and temperature sensors to the measuring point. Follows the sensors with the pump. Monitors DO variation during purging.
Checks for and eliminates chamber back pressure.
Notes that accumulated sediment in the cell can adversely affect sensors.
Records onsite conditions that could have affected data quality.
Uses relatively gas-impermeable high-density plastic or fluorocarbon-polymer tubing.
Dislodges and flushes entrained bubbles from tubing and chamber.
Keeps tubing fittings secure so air does not enter the cell.
Specifies a positive-displacement submersible pump for the ex situ DO setup. Specifies relatively gas-impermeable high-density plastic or fluorocarbon-polymer tubing.
Protects exposed tubing and the chamber from direct sunlight.
